title: No test checks who gets the plate and warm-up calculators, or that the rest timer stays free
what: No test shows the locked explanation to a member without Plus, opens the calculators for a member whose gym gives free Plus, or closes them again when the gym plan ends. No test checks the rest timer has no Plus lock either. The Plus flow on the phone mentions the calculators in its notes but never opens one.
expected: Tests open the calculators as a free member (locked, with a way to Plus), as a gym member with free Plus (open), after the gym plan ends (locked again), and check the rest timer works the same without Plus.
fix_line: Add a phone test that opens the calculators as a free, a gym-Plus and an ended-gym member, and the rest timer without Plus

title: The plate calculator sheet and the warm-up button are never opened in a test
what: Only the maths is tested. No test opens the sheet from a barbell exercise, sees 'Plate calculator' hidden on a dumbbell or machine, reads 'Using a 20 kg bar (your usual).', 'Can't make 101 kg with your plates' with its 'Next up' line, or 'Just the bar'. No test sees the message when Plates and bars cannot open, or 'Set a working weight first' when no weight is typed.
expected: A screen test opens the sheet on a barbell set, checks each line and the bar chips, and checks the two failure messages.
fix_line: Add a screen test that opens the calculator and warm-up button on a barbell set and checks their words

title: Adding, changing and removing the profile photo is never tested on screen
what: Only the file copying is tested. No test opens Edit profile, sees 'Add photo' and the 'Profile photo' sheet, waits through 'Saving the photo…', sees the new photo on the Profile tab, removes it and sees the first letter again, or sees 'Camera not allowed' after a refused camera. A plain cancel keeping the old photo is not checked either.
expected: A screen test adds, changes and removes the profile photo, checks the Profile tab each time, and checks the refused-camera and cancel cases.
fix_line: Add a screen test for adding, changing, removing and cancelling the profile photo

title: The Profile tab's three numbers and its empty state are never checked
what: The phone flow checks the chart and the Your progress rows only. No test reads the Workouts, Streak and Records numbers, checks 'week' against 'weeks', sees 'No workouts yet. Each one you finish shows here.' for a new member, checks there is no Next line without a routine, or taps the Next line to reach the Workout tab.
expected: Tests check the three numbers for a member with workouts and for a new member, the empty words, and that the Next line opens the Workout tab.
fix_line: Add checks of the Profile header numbers, the empty state and the Next line tap

title: Nothing checks the switched-off Ready today card stays off, and the page old links open is no longer tested
what: The only phone flow for Muscles ready today and Quick workout was taken out of the run when the owner switched the feature off, and no test checks the card and button are now gone from the Workout tab. The Ready today page still opens from an old link, but no test that still runs opens it.
expected: A test checks the Workout tab has no Ready today card or Quick workout button, and that an old link to the page shows it without a crash or a workout started.
fix_line: Add a check that the card is gone, and one that the old link still opens the page

title: A wrong, dead or half-read Hevy link is never tested on screen
what: The phone flow pastes one good folder link and checks older words ('We found 6 routines'). No test pastes a link that is not Hevy's, a link Hevy says is gone, or reads a folder where only some routines load and sees 'Try again' and 'Use these 4'. The 'Reading your Hevy link…' wait with its Cancel button and the 'This updates the routines in' line for a folder copied before are not checked.
expected: Tests paste a non-Hevy link, a dead link and a part-read folder and check each message and button, and copy the same folder again to see the update line.
fix_line: Add screen tests for a wrong, dead and half-read Hevy link and a second copy of a folder

title: A Strong file, a renamed folder and the empty or failed routine steps are never tested
what: The phone flow imports a Hevy file only, into a folder still named From Hevy. No test imports a Strong file and sees 'From Strong', updates a folder the member renamed, or checks the name is not set back. 'Every exercise is unticked, so there is nothing to save' and the failed-save message that says new exercises stayed in the library are never checked.
expected: Tests import a Strong file, import a Hevy file again after renaming its folder, untick every exercise, and fail a save, checking each message.
fix_line: Add tests for a Strong file, a renamed folder, nothing ticked and a failed routine save

title: The 'Update routine?' question is never tested for a failed save, a second ask or a deleted routine
what: Only the change sentence is tested. No test checks the question waits until the summary is open, is asked once per workout, is not asked for a routine that no longer exists, or that 'Couldn't update the routine. Your workout is saved; the routine is unchanged.' shows when the save fails and the routine stays whole. Nothing checks a swapped-in stand-in exercise stays out of the routine.
expected: Tests finish a changed routine workout and check the question once, after Keep original, for a deleted routine, and for a failed save.
fix_line: Add tests for the update question asked once, for a deleted routine and for a failed save

title: The 'Save as routine' card after a first workout is never seen on screen
what: Only the rule for when the card is offered is tested. No test finishes a first empty workout and sees the card, taps 'Save as routine' and sees 'Saved in My routines', checks the routine has the right sets and name, or sees 'Couldn't save the routine. Your workout is saved.' with the button still there.
expected: A screen test finishes a first empty workout, saves it as a routine, checks the routine, and checks the failed-save message.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the first-workout Save as routine card and its failure

title: Moving a saved workout to another day is tested only as clock maths
what: The tests check the start and end move together. No test opens 'Editing a saved workout', changes the day and checks History, the heatmap and the week all move it, saves with no sets and sees 'Nothing to save', edits a workout deleted meanwhile, discards and sees the old date kept, or checks records move to the workout that really came first. The gym's leaderboard after a re-dated workout is not checked.
expected: Tests re-date a workout on screen and check every place it shows, the three refusals, discard, records and the leaderboard.
fix_line: Add a screen test that re-dates a saved workout and checks History, records and the refusals

title: The 'times your best' figure is tested only on round numbers
what: The test asks about 300 kg on a 75 kg best (exactly 4) and 187.5 kg (exactly 2.5). It never tries a figure like 3.75 that must round down to 3.5, so a change that rounds up to 4 would pass.
expected: The test also checks an in-between figure, such as 300 kg on an 80 kg best reading '3.5×'.
fix_line: Add one in-between case to the typo question test

title: The 'Share Jaipur' sheet and the no-share-app message are never tested
what: The routine text and file are tested as data. No test opens the share sheet from a folder, checks its title and the 'Send as text' and 'Send as a file' rows, sees 'Routines added' after opening a file, or sees 'Sharing is not available' on a phone with no app to send with.
expected: A screen test shares a folder as text and as a file, opens the file, and checks the no-share-app message.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the routine share sheet and the no-share-app message
